# TEST-ONLY certificates

Everything in this directory is generated by `../gen-certs.sh` for the control plane and
runtime tests (mTLS between the runtime gateway client and the gateway server).

**The private keys (`*.key`) are committed on purpose, are publicly known, and must never be used
outside tests.** They protect nothing: do not trust the CA (`ca.pem`, `rogue-ca.pem`), do not
install it in any trust store, and do not copy any of these files into a deployment. The CA
private key is not committed, so these certificates cannot be extended.

Production certificates are issued by your own PKI; see `docs/operations.md`.
